text_block_list.text:
Having somehow overcome her gate aversion—
the day of her grand stage has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Today is finally Turbo's Make a Debut!
Do your best, Turbo...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wait... Huh? Aren't they missing?
choice_data_list: Where on earth are you going!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...
Nature~, Ikuno~, Trainer~.
There're too many people, I'm scared~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"So many people"...? It's still a morning race, you know?
I don't think the turnout is big enough to be scared of.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there, there…… You okay?
All the color's drained from your face……
Like you're wearing a white mask or something……

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Though her gate aversion has improved slightly,
at this rate...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"First, let's calm down and breathe,
Turbo-san.
...What should we do, Trainer-san?"

Even so—I have to encourage her somehow
and get her in the mood to run.
For Twin Turbo's sake.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Turbo can't run properly
like this at aaaaall...
I don't wanna, I don't wanna! It's scary...

...Twin Turbo is trying her hardest in her own way.
It seems that's putting extra pressure on her.
In that case—
choice_data_list: It's fine even if you can't run properly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Is that okay?
But~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Against... myself...? Against... Turbo's limits...?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can definitely do that!
As long as everything else doesn't matter!
choice_data_list: Go ahead and run however you like!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Turbo's off!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...Just as expected. It seems trust really is what matters most at times like these."

I provided the bare minimum support.
The rest is up to her, but...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: U-U-Uuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ain't that Twin Turbo?☆
Is she, like, super-duper freaked out?

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume P
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like it.
Why don't we go say a quick word?

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume P
text_block_list.text:
Calm down, Twin Turbo!
It's gonna be okay!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Is someone... cheering for Turbo?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright... alriiiight, let's do this~.
Turbo Power, half-throttle full speeeed!
